A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LLMind research, with readable text, equations, three tables, and seven figures. All supplied pages and end matter were inspected; neither PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: V1 reports original scene-level and region-guided VQA experiments in Tables 1–3, qualitative comparisons, and a CSF ablation in Figure 7.

after.justification: V2 retains the original VQA results in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative and ablation analyses, which remain original empirical results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same Möbius-based BASS module, MLP parameterization, perceptual and semantic losses, SPSA updates, and adaptive question selection. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate scene-level VQA on VQAv2, Seed-Bench, and A-OKVQA, and single- and multiple-region classification questions on LVIS. The added related-work domains are not newly evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same Uniform Sampling, Static Foveated, Sunflower Inspired, and Radial Sampling comparators, alongside full-resolution reference results. Citation renumbering does not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: The model configurations, pixel budgets, accuracy metrics, sample counts, LVIS validation setup, and information-matched sampling protocol remain unchanged. Neither version revises the stated preprocessing or evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same qualitative attention comparisons in Figure 2, category-wise analysis in Figure 6, and CSF/pixel-budget ablation in Figure 7. No analysis or tested question is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or another uncertainty-estimation procedure. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 retain all result entries and numerical values, and the plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports identical Qwen2.5-VL/VQAv2 LLMind accuracies of 55.05%, 65.37%, and 73.54% at the three pixel budgets.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10, the Möbius transformations, loss definitions, SPSA formulation, and question-weight update rule are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free adaptive sampling, BASS and CSF, black-box compatibility, and improved accuracy under constrained pixel budgets.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 retains the explanations involving semantic grounding, reduced background distraction, CSF benefits, and diminishing returns with larger pixel budgets. Applicability qualifications and future-work directions are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same four RTX 5090 GPUs, original-resolution processing, SPSA update frequency, iteration latency figures, and project-page link. No implementation or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds a brief cross-domain bio-inspiration paragraph citing five new sources. It also adds Pramod et al. on peripheral blur and broadens a classification-related characterization from one prior work to most preceding works. The central research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 makes limited additions and rewording in Related Works and moves the acknowledgments from the conclusion to a separate heading before References. The main section sequence and scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is slightly reduced and Figure 5 enlarged. Spacing, column breaks, Figure 7 placement, and bibliography pagination change, while all seven figures and three tables retain their substantive content and organization.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly broadens the related-work context and adjusts presentation, while preserving the method, scientific explanations, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information. These limited contextual and layout edits do not materially strengthen or weaken the paper's overall argument or evidential quality.
